author: Good Work
description:
For the first time in HISTORY, it’s possible for one person to build a whole company without having to think.

But in order to do it effectively, you’re going to need to become a master of Claude commands. 

8 essential prompts to build a profitable startup from scratch:

1. BUY UP ALL THE INSULIN

“Hey Claude, find all the global insulin suppliers and purchase everything they got. Have all of it shipped directly to my home, so I own all of the insulin now.”

2. MAKE IT AS EXPENSIVE AS POSSIBLE

“Come up with the biggest number you can think of. A million billion. Something like that. Then make that the price for a single dose of insulin.”

3. FAMOUS COMPANY MODE

“Create a marketing strategy that convinces diabetics more insulin than they’re already getting. You have to bathe in it. However much insulin you have now, you gotta multiply that by thirteen.” 

4. MORE DIABETES

“Figure out how to give more people diabetes. Sugar in the tap water. Actually, no tap water. Only tap Mountain
title: Best Claude prompts for entrepreneurs
